rationale: The original entry thesis required price to hold above the 5-min VWAP ($153.43) and 9-EMA ($154.02) as intraday anchors; the last two candles show a clean break below VWAP on accelerating volume (8,524 shares, the heaviest since entry), with price now at $153.37 — structure has shifted from consolidation to distribution. The maximum favorable excursion was only 0.15% against a current adverse excursion of -0.51%, confirming buyers never committed, and with the invalidation level ($152.90) just $0.47 away there is insufficient reward-to-risk to continue holding a position whose core premise is already broken.
